description.name: Entry
description.text:
Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1, Instant SB/LB Cast 1 & chases a SB/LB cast with single-target DeProtect 30% or DeShell 30% for 5 seconds (max 1 chase)
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Prismatic/NE ranged hybrid attacks, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1 + DeProtect or DeShell for 5 seconds, Instant Cast 1 to user, removes Master Mode
